mapper.insert: insert into bedrock_admin_online (id, admin_id, token_id, token, token_expired, last_heartbeat_time, online_status, ws_only_id, login_time, client_ip) values (#{adminOnline.id}, #{adminOnline.adminId}, #{adminOnline.tokenId}, #{adminOnline.token}, #{adminOnline.tokenExpired}, #{adminOnline.lastHeartbeatTime}, #{adminOnline.onlineStatus}, #{adminOnline.wsOnlyId}, #{adminOnline.loginTime}, #{adminOnline.clientIp}) on duplicate key update admin_id = #{adminOnline.adminId}, token_id = #{adminOnline.tokenId}, token = #{adminOnline.token}, token_expired = #{adminOnline.tokenExpired}, last_heartbeat_time = #{adminOnline.lastHeartbeatTime}, online_status = #{adminOnline.onlineStatus}, ws_only_id = #{adminOnline.wsOnlyId}, login_time = #{adminOnline.loginTime}, client_ip = #{adminOnline.clientIp}
mapper.select: select bedrock_admin_online.admin_id, bedrock_admin_online.token_id, bedrock_admin_online.token_expired, bedrock_admin_online.ws_only_id, bedrock_admin_online.client_ip, bedrock_admin.username, bedrock_admin.nickname, bedrock_admin.phone, bedrock_admin.email, bedrock_admin.avatar from bedrock_admin_online inner join bedrock_admin on bedrock_admin_online.admin_id = bedrock_admin.id where online_status = 1 and bedrock_admin_online.last_heartbeat_time > #{lastHeartbeatTime} order by bedrock_admin_online.login_time desc
